author.name: Jungho Oh, Woosung Kim, Dong Hyeon Mok, Jonggeol Na, Seoin Back

entry.summary: Introduces CatRetriever, a contrastive representation learning model that aligns generated catalyst slab structures with their parent bulk structures, framing the missing slab-to-bulk connection in generative catalyst discovery as a retrieval problem. This enables assessment of bulk-dependent properties like formation and surface energy.

entry.title: An End-to-End Hybrid Quantum--Classical Sampling Workflow for Discrete Markov Random Fields: A Reproducible Case Study

author.name: Arul Rhik Mazumder

entry.summary: Studies amplitude-encoded quantum i.i.d. sampling for small discrete Markov random fields, comparing it fairly against tuned classical MCMC samplers. It reports that modern classical samplers substantially close the gap once preprocessing is amortized.

entry.title: DynaFilter: Cloud-driven Dynamic Filtering for Satellite Edge Intelligence

author.name: Ziyang Zhang, Jie Liu, Luca Mottola

entry.summary: Designs DynaFilter, a technique that lets bandwidth-constrained satellite edge devices perform selective region-of-interest inference directly in the compressed domain without full decompression, using low-level compression syntax. It reduces unnecessary data transmission to the cloud.

entry.title: TSCoNet: A Two-Stage Copula CNN-LSTM for Uncertainty-Aware Spatio-Temporal Forecasting

author.name: Jongwook Kim, Jong-Min Kim

entry.summary: Introduces TSCoNet, a two-stage CNN-LSTM coupled with a Gaussian copula that jointly forecasts multiple correlated environmental variables over space and time while quantifying predictive uncertainty. It addresses the accuracy-uncertainty tradeoff for strongly correlated variables.

entry.title: SPORT: Structure-Aware Prototype Disentanglement for Incomplete Multi-View Clustering

author.name: Yaoyuan Guo, Zhibin Gu, Songhe Feng, Yuhui Zheng, Bing Li

entry.summary: Proposes SPORT, a prototype-based method for incomplete multi-view clustering that disentangles view-specific from shared prototype information, preserves cluster-level structure, and uses local neighborhood geometry for missing-view imputation. It addresses three limitations of prior prototype methods.

entry.title: RecRec: Recursive Refinement for Sequential Recommendation

author.name: Pervez Shaik, Prosenjit Biswas, Abhinav Thorat, Ravi Kolla, Niranjan Pedanekar

entry.summary: Proposes RecRec, a lightweight sequential recommender that models user preferences as a persistent latent state recursively refined by a shared module, with an evidence-anchored correction mechanism for stability. It revisits sequential recommendation from a recursive inference perspective.

entry.title: Beyond Looking Up, Try Looking Around: Harmonizing Global Structure and Local Consistency in Optimal Transport for Short Text Clustering

author.name: Zhihao Yao, Yuxuan Gu, Jixuan Yin, Bo Li

entry.summary: Proposes a short-text clustering framework that adds instance-level attention to capture semantic relationships and integrates it into the optimal-transport pseudo-labeling formulation to enforce semantic consistency. This reduces erroneous pseudo-labels for semantically similar samples.

entry.title: Overcoming Fourier Locking in Quantum Data Re-uploading Classifiers via Spectral Homotopy

author.name: Spencer Topel

entry.summary: Identifies Fourier locking as the primary optimization bottleneck in data re-uploading quantum classifiers, where nonlinearly coupled encoding weights collapse into spurious minima on high-frequency targets. It proposes a spectral homotopy method and Fisher-information diagnostics to overcome it.

entry.title: MMRM: A Multiplex Multimodal Representation Model for Product Ranking in E-commerce Search

author.name: Zhen-Lin Chen, Maosen Sheng, Peng Lin, Jianmin Chen, Zhuojian Xiao, Dongyue Wang, Xiwei Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes MMRM, a multiplex multimodal representation model for e-commerce search ranking that fine-tunes multimodal LLMs with multiple heterogeneous collaborative signals and leverages the representations for user behavior modeling rather than as plain item features. It addresses reliance on a single collaborative signal and underuse of multimodal features.

entry.title: Comparison-Based Ordinal Learning for Proactive Driving Risk Assessment

author.name: Zhuoren Li, Yi Zhong, Weiqi Zhang, Xinrui Zhang, Lu Xiong, Chongfeng Wei, Bo Leng

entry.summary: Proposes a comparison-based ordinal learning framework that learns collision-relevant driving risk scores from pairwise supervision, directly modeling relative risk ordering without numerical frame-level labels. It addresses scarcity of collision data and misalignment of surrogate risk objectives.

entry.title: LaGuadia: Language-Guided Adaptive Distillation from Pathology Foundation Models

author.name: Gangsu Kim, Won-Ki Jeong

entry.summary: Proposes LaGuadia, a language-guided adaptive multi-teacher distillation framework that builds a compact pathology image encoder by dynamically weighting multiple pathology foundation models under clinical linguistic guidance. It replaces suboptimal uniform teacher weighting with tissue-heterogeneity-aware integration.

entry.title: Simple Features and Honest Calibration for Ambivalence and Hesitancy Recognition in Video

author.name: Vikas Kumar, Aditya Mishra, Haroon R. Lone

entry.summary: Describes a system for the ABAW 2026 challenge that recognizes ambivalence and hesitancy from interview videos by fusing affect-specialized text, audio, and visual features with linguistic hesitation cues via a reliability gate. It introduces ASR-erased time features derived from deleted fillers and pauses as a strong non-verbal channel.

entry.title: Forgetting Our Way to Shared Meaning: Effects of Forgetting on Conceptual Alignment in a Non-Partnership Coordination Game

author.name: Landon Liu, Mary Kelly, Alan Tsang

entry.summary: Models conceptual alignment among agents as a non-partnership coordination game and simulates how memory adaptiveness and forgetting affect the emergence of shared meaning. It finds adaptive players converge faster and that perceived versus actual convergence can diverge.

entry.title: A Dual-Stream Challenge-Response Protocol for Ocular Liveness Verification

author.name: Ismail Kably

entry.summary: Proposes a dual-stream challenge-response protocol for ocular liveness verification that fuses spatial gaze trajectory and luminance-driven pupillary response into a single time-varying visual stimulus. It aims to defeat presentation attacks like video replays and real-time deepfakes that spoof isolated physiological signals.

entry.title: EMBRACE: A Multi-task Framework for Comprehensive Quality Assessment in Cleavage-stage Embryo

author.name: Anwar Hussain Sofi, Jung-Hua Wang, Ming-Jer Chen, Tsung-Hsien Lee, Yu-Chiao Yi, Ming-Kuan Lin, Yi-Chung Lai

entry.summary: Introduces EMBRACE, a multi-task deep learning framework that jointly performs cytoplasmic-fragmentation segmentation, developmental-stage classification, and blastomere-symmetry grading from cleavage-stage embryo microscopy images. It targets the observer variability of manual embryo assessment in IVF.

entry.title: BOCCHI: A More Realistic and Challenging Benchmark for Local Motion Blur Detection with MSDCT-UNet

author.name: Kuan-Lin Chen, Yuan-Kang Lee, Cheng-Yuan Chiang, Jian-Jiun Ding

entry.summary: Introduces BOCCHI, a real-captured local motion-blur detection benchmark whose sharp regions overlap the blur gradient distribution to defeat gradient shortcuts, and MSDCT-UNet, a frequency-aware encoder-decoder using multi-scale DCT priors. Models trained on BOCCHI generalize better across datasets with few training images.

entry.title: Quantum Compressed Sensing CT Reconstruction Algorithm Based on Penalized Weighted Least Squares and Guided Total Variation

author.name: Yuwen Zhang, Yujie Liu, Ao Wang, Yikuang Yuluo, Shuangyang Zhong, Haijun Yu, Yixing Huang

entry.summary: Proposes a quantum compressed-sensing CT reconstruction method within a QUBO framework that incorporates penalized weighted least squares for photon-count reliability and guided total variation using SART-derived edge priors. It addresses neglected photon-counting statistics and anatomical heterogeneity in prior QUBO-based sparse-view CT.

entry.title: FoundationGeo: Learning Spatial Pixel-Wise Fields for Monocular Metric Geometry

author.name: Muxin Liu (The University of Hong Kong, Voyager Research, DiDi Chuxing), Xiaoyang Lyu (The University of Hong Kong), Tianhe Ren (The University of Hong Kong), Peng Dai (The University of Hong Kong), Xiaoshan Wu (The University of Hong Kong), Zhiyue Zhang (The University of Hong Kong), Jiaqi Zhang (The University of Hong Kong), Jiehong Lin (The University of Hong Kong), Shaoshuai Shi (Voyager Research, DiDi Chuxing), Xiaojuan Qi (The University of Hong Kong)

entry.summary: FoundationGeo is a two-stage framework for monocular metric geometry that first learns an affine-invariant geometry model initialized from DINOv3 on a curated 10.2M-sample corpus, then adds lightweight pixel-wise scale and ray-direction correction fields for metric estimation. It produces metrically consistent 3D point maps with sharp boundaries and strong cross-domain generalization.

entry.title: Read It Back: Pretrained MLLMs Are Zero-Shot Reward Models for Text-to-Image Generation

author.name: Runhui Huang, Qihui Zhang, Zhe Liu, Yu Gao, Jie Wu, Hengshuang Zhao

entry.summary: SpectraReward is a training-free reward function that turns pretrained MLLMs into off-the-shelf reward models for image-generation RL by measuring how well the original prompt can be recovered from a generated image via a single teacher-forced forward pass. It reuses the MLLM's pretrained image-text alignment without preference labels or reward-model fine-tuning.

entry.title: TAC-LOCO: Unified Whole-Body Control for Quadrupedal TACtile-Informed LOCO-Manipulation

author.name: Muqun Hu, Yuhao Zhou, Kabir Ray Malik, Chi Lin, Won Suk Lee, Yu She, Yan Gu

entry.summary: TAC-LOCO is a tactile-augmented unified reinforcement learning framework for quadrupedal loco-manipulation that encodes compliant-gripper tactile arrays with proprioception to jointly control legs, arm, and gripper. It regulates grasp stability under uncertain external forces rather than gripping rigidly.

entry.title: PIER-Flow: Physics-Informed Efficient Rectified Flow for Real-Time Mobile Robot Navigation

author.name: Shibo Li, Zhongcheng Wang, Jiahe Cao, Jianhua Yang, Ke Wu

entry.summary: PIER-Flow distills an MPC expert into a continuous-time rectified flow policy for real-time mobile robot navigation, capturing multimodal avoidance while enabling low-latency inference. It combines physical feasibility with fast one-step-like generation avoiding slow denoising.

entry.title: SUREFlow: State-space Uncertainty-aware REsidual Flow Matching for Robust Robot Manipulation

author.name: Md Tanvir Islam, Sai Navaneet Peddapalli, Sangmoon Lee, Sangtae Ahn

entry.summary: SUREFlow is a Mamba-backbone residual flow-matching policy for robot manipulation that jointly predicts action velocities and input-dependent residual uncertainty, enabling selective refinement of unreliable action dimensions during rollouts. It targets stability under noise, partial observability, and stochastic initial conditions.

entry.title: Dual-Process Atomic Skill Learning: Decoupling Semantic Reasoning and Real-Time Control

author.name: Jun Chen, Erdent Bao, Wenlong Dong, Jierui Liu, Qi Cai, Hao Wan, Shaopeng Li, Weijun Qin, Jing Liang, Huiping Zhuang

entry.summary: DASL is an asynchronous hierarchical imitation learning framework that decouples slow semantic skill reasoning from fast real-time low-level control, inspired by dual-process cognition, to address training instability and codebook collapse in joint hierarchical training. It targets multi-step compositional language-conditioned tasks.

entry.title: SensorPerch: Sense Wherever and Whenever it Matters

author.name: Zhanxin Wu, Ruofei Tong, Tapomayukh Bhattacharjee

entry.summary: SensorPerch introduces an active perception paradigm where lightweight wireless sensors are treated as detachable physical entities a robot can autonomously place and re-attach in the environment, decoupling sensing from both robot embodiment and fixed infrastructure. This enables task-adaptive, informative viewpoints.

entry.title: SegDiff: Segmented Trajectory Diffusion for Consistent and Adaptive Robot Manipulation

author.name: Haidong Cao, Wenjun Cao, Quanhao Li, Sicheng Xie, Zhiying Du, Jiaqi Leng, Zuxuan Wu, Yu-Gang Jiang

entry.summary: SegDiff is a closed-loop visuomotor diffusion policy that decomposes demonstrations into motion segments between keyposes and predicts continuous trajectories from the current state, combining the strengths of continuous prediction and keypose methods. It avoids external planners while reducing compounding errors and handling multimodality.

entry.title: GraspGraphNet: Graph-Structured Multi-Embodiment Dexterous Grasp Generation

author.name: Yeonseo Lee, Taeyeop Lee, Hyosup Shin, Guebin Hwang, Sungho Jo

entry.summary: GraspGraphNet is a topology-aware grasp generation framework that represents each robot hand as a URDF-derived kinematic graph and uses conditional flow matching to directly output executable palm poses and joint configurations across different hand embodiments. It avoids post-processing, inverse kinematics, and retargeting.

entry.title: PAKE: Learning Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation with Partial Kinematic Embeddings

author.name: Zhengmao He, Moonkyu Jung, Hyeongjun Kim, Jiseong Lee, Hui Zhang, Jemin Hwangbo, Jie Song

entry.summary: PAKE decomposes whole-body loco-manipulation into partial reference motion generation and low-level imitation control, introducing a Kinematic Normalizing Flow trained on a large kinematic dataset to generate diverse feasible partial motions. A high-level controller navigates the flow model latent space to exploit whole-body redundancy.

entry.title: WarpMPC: Large-Batch MPC on GPU via ADMM with Unrolled $LDL^\top$ Factorization

author.name: Henrik Hose, Se Hwan Jeon, Charles Khazoom, Sangbae Kim, Sebastian Trimpe

entry.summary: WarpMPC introduces GPU numerical optimizations for solving large batches (tens of thousands) of structurally identical SQP/MPC problems by unrolling sparse LDL-transpose factorizations within an ADMM solver, with optimized memory layout and padding-reducing segmentation. Implemented in JAX and Warp for massive-batch MPC.

entry.title: DA-Nav: Direction-Aware City-Scale Vision-Language Navigation

author.name: Ye Yuan, Kehan Chen, Xinqiang Yu, Wentao Xu, Heng Wang, Libo Huang, Chuanguang Yang, Yan Huang, Jiawei He, Zhulin An

entry.summary: DA-Nav is a direction-aware city-scale vision-language navigation framework that leverages directional instructions from commercial navigation tools and reformulates navigation as discrete spatial grounding on the egocentric 2D image plane. It uses chain-of-thought reasoning for deviation assessment and trajectory recovery to reduce reliance on dense maps or costly supervision.

entry.title: AutoPath: Learning Transferable Goal-Conditioned Stochastic Path Prior for Safe Navigation Without Human Demonstrations

author.name: Ziyang Zhang, Boyang Zhou, Zesong Yang, Haocheng Peng, Zeming Gai, Xiao Liang, Yujun Shen, Danping Zou, Ruizhen Hu, Hujun Bao, Zhaopeng Cui

entry.summary: AutoPath formulates navigation as learning a transferable goal-conditioned stochastic path prior that models a reusable distribution over goal-aligned, geometry-consistent local paths from local observations, without human demonstrations. A goal-aligned canonical state representation enables structured multimodal path sampling transferable across robots.

entry.title: Can AI be Conscious in Ohio?

author.name: Austin Smith

entry.summary: Examines a wave of US state bills that would ban legal personhood for AI systems and/or declare AI systems non-conscious, four of which have already passed. The authors argue declaring AI non-conscious is premature since consciousness is an unresolved scientific and philosophical question lawmakers cannot settle.

entry.title: Learning Linear Temporal Specifications from Demonstrations with Uncertainty

author.name: Parastou Fahim, Constantino Lagoa, R\^omulo Meira-G'oes

entry.summary: Presents a framework for learning minimal Linear Temporal Logic formulas from noisy or incomplete demonstrations, modeling uncertainty via Hamming distance around observed traces. Relevant to formal verification and controller synthesis in safety-critical settings.

entry.title: The Hidden Footprint: Making Storage a First-Class Metric for LLM Agent Evaluation

author.name: Chenglin Yu, Hongquan Gui, Ying Yu, Hongxia Yang, Ming Li

entry.summary: Introduces AgentFootprint, a cross-framework benchmark measuring the persistent on-disk storage an agent run leaves behind (logs, checkpoints, debug traces). It exposes measurement traps where naive byte counts understate duplication by an order of magnitude.

entry.title: Modernizing HEBO: a robust Bayesian optimization baseline for practical heteroskedastic and non-stationary problems

author.name: L. A. Zhukov, E. V. Shaburova, D. V. Antonets

entry.summary: Reimplements and modernizes heteroskedastic evolutionary Bayesian optimization as tidyHEBO in BoTorch, revising surrogate training, output warping, acquisition evaluation, and Pareto search for robust performance on noisy, non-stationary lab optimization problems. It targets data-efficient experimentation in chemistry and materials science.

entry.title: Saturation-Aware Robust Trajectory Optimization for Reusable Launch Vehicles via Differentiable Physics

author.name: Liwei Chen, Tong Qin

entry.summary: Presents a differentiable physics framework for robust trajectory optimization of reusable launch vehicle flip maneuvers, embedding actuator saturation directly into the computational graph. It uses a particle ensemble to shape uncertainty evolution.

entry.title: Runtime Safety Filtering for Learned Small UAS Separation Policies under GNSS Degradation

author.name: Alex Zongo, Peng Wei

entry.summary: Investigates whether runtime safety filters for learned drone separation policies should filter actions or observations under GNSS degradation in urban environments. It evaluates both architectures against adversarial navigation degradation for multi-agent separation.

entry.title: TVT-PAPD: Pathology-Aware Prototype Distillation for Self-Supervised Whole Slide Image Classification

author.name: Ramesh Naidu Laveti, Jaya Sreevalsan-Nair, T K Srikanth

entry.summary: Proposes a tiny vision transformer with pathology-aware prototype distillation for self-supervised whole-slide image classification, using a learnable prototype bank to capture disease-relevant morphology. It aims to inject pathology-specific patterns absent from generic SSL features.

entry.title: Question Type, Cognitive Load, and CEFR Alignment: Evaluating LLM-Generated EFL Grammar Drill Exercises

author.name: Steve Woollaston, Brendan Flanagan, Yuko Toyokawa, Hiroaki Ogata

entry.summary: Analyzes log data from Japanese junior-high students to evaluate LLM-generated EFL grammar exercises, finding a clear difficulty hierarchy across question modalities and validating CEFR-J difficulty tiers empirically. It informs pedagogically sound use of LLM-generated learning content.

entry.title: TDSal: Task-Based Top-Down Saliency Prediction Model

author.name: Can Mizrakli, Tolga K. Capin

entry.summary: Introduces TDSal, a task-driven saliency model that conditions visual attention prediction on natural-language task descriptions to produce task-dependent saliency maps. It targets goal-directed rather than free-viewing attention modeling.

entry.title: Reliability-Aware Ensemble Classification Under Class Imbalance: A Calibration Study on Liquid-Based Cervical Cytology

author.name: Nisreen Albzour, Sarah S. Lam

entry.summary: Studies reliability-aware, calibration-aware ensemble classification of liquid-based cervical cytology under class imbalance using the native four-class Bethesda taxonomy and post-hoc temperature scaling. It emphasizes realistic small, imbalanced clinical settings rather than curated balanced benchmarks.

entry.title: Water Reflection Detection Using Symmetric Attention

author.name: Shuxuan Yao, Chengjia Wang, Jianyuan Sun, Junyu Dong, Xinghui Dong

entry.summary: Introduces SAWRD-Net, a water reflection detection network that exploits the imperfect reflective symmetry of water using dihedral group-equivariant convolutions and a matrix-decomposition decoder to detect reflection axes. It aims to reduce false positives and negatives caused by confusing objects with their water reflections.

entry.title: h-Flow: Flexible Flow-based Image Editing via Doob's h-Transform

author.name: Zehui Guo, Zhen Wang, Junwei Shu, Yang Li, Changbo Wang, Long Chen

entry.summary: h-Flow is a training-free, theoretically grounded image editing framework that reformulates editing as conditional generation under multiple terminal events using Doob's h-Transform, extended from SDE-based models to flow models. It aims to balance target alignment and source consistency without inversion pipelines or architecture-specific heuristics.

entry.title: FlowPET: Physics-Informed Symplectic Flow Matching for Low-Count PET Reconstruction

author.name: Zheng Zhang, Hao Tang, Yingying Hu, Zhanli Hu, Jing Qin

entry.summary: FlowPET reformulates low-count PET reconstruction as volume-preserving transport in a symplectic phase space using a separable Hamiltonian system that guarantees a divergence-free vector field. This prevents the numerical extinction of weak but diagnostically critical lesion signals that dissipative generative models cause.

entry.title: GDP.pdf: Benchmarking Grounded Multimodal Reasoning over Professional PDF Documents

author.name: Suhaas Garre, Emily Ritchie, Sushant Mehta, Edwin Chen

entry.summary: GDP.pdf is a benchmark for grounded multimodal reasoning over professional PDF documents, with question-document pairs authored by working professionals across ten fields and kept only when at least two frontier models failed meaningfully. It measures realistic end-to-end document QA rather than isolated OCR, layout, or chart skills.

entry.title: Actor as Its Own Critic: Unifying Region Understanding and Localization via CycleGRPO

author.name: Xin Zhang, Haochen Wang, Yikang Zhou, Jason Li, Robby T. Tan

entry.summary: CycleGRPO is a unified reinforcement learning framework where a single MLLM acts as both actor and critic in a region-to-text-to-region cycle, jointly optimizing region understanding and localization without textual ground truth. It leverages the duality between captioning and grounding to build a self-evaluating training paradigm requiring only region inputs.

entry.title: Latent-Identity Tuning in Text-to-Image Personalization Models

author.name: Daniel Garibi, Ronen Kamenetsky, Hadar Averbuch-Elor, Daniel Cohen-Or, Or Patashnik

entry.summary: This work introduces latent-identity tuning for text-to-image personalization that modifies the latent representation of a specific identity rather than editing a given image, enabling generation of diverse images consistently depicting the same edited identity. It explores the latent space of a frozen encoder for fine-grained facial edits.

entry.title: Learning to Navigate Efficiently with Only 0.58M Trainable Parameters

author.name: Edward Beng Wai Tan, Siew-Kei Lam

entry.summary: Presents a decomposed visual navigation model where closed-form operations (projective geometry, occupancy, coordinate transforms) serve as interfaces between three small learned modules, achieving efficient navigation with only 0.58M trainable parameters. It challenges the assumption that navigation requires massive scale.

entry.title: An Extreme Value Perspective on Learning Stress Laws

author.name: Mantu Gupta, Anand Deo

entry.summary: Proposes SS-GEN, a generative method that decomposes multivariate tail distributions into radial and angular components to simulate extreme events and estimate rare-event probabilities in heavy- and light-tailed settings. It provides asymptotic exactness guarantees for tail densities using off-the-shelf deep generative models.

entry.title: A Multi-Agent Framework for Zero-Dimensional Reduced-Order Model Planning

author.name: Bingteng Sun, Hao Yin, Yiling Chen, Renjie Xiao, Lei Xie, Shanyou Wang, Ruonan Wang, Shubao Chen, Qingzong Xu, Lin Lu, Qiang Du, Junqiang Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-agent LLM framework for planning zero-dimensional reduced-order models used in complex equipment design, going beyond single-agent CoT/ReAct/RAG approaches to handle long-horizon, highly coupled topology exploration. It targets engineering design workflows.

entry.title: Learning Subgroup Relations Using Siamese Graph Neural Networks

author.name: Tal Weissblat

entry.summary: Proposes a Siamese Graph Neural Network operating on Cayley graph representations combined with algebraic features to predict whether one finite group is isomorphic to a subgroup of another. It applies learned graph embeddings to a computational group theory problem.

entry.title: NeuroMem-FHP: A Likelihood-Free Deep Learning Framework for Parameter Estimation of Fractional Hawkes Process

author.name: Neha Gupta, Aditya Maheshwari

entry.summary: Proposes NeuroMem-FHP, a likelihood-free deep learning framework using LSTM and Transformer models to estimate parameters of the fractional Hawkes process directly from inter-arrival times, avoiding costly likelihood optimization. Neural estimators, especially the Transformer, outperform maximum likelihood on synthetic data.

entry.title: Physics-Aware Conditional SetGAN for Spatially Consistent Multi-User TR 38.901 Channel Generation

author.name: Mauro Gonzalo Tarazona-Levano, David Lopez-Perez, Nicola Piovesan, David Gomez-Barquero

entry.summary: Proposes a physics-aware, geometry-conditioned SetGAN trained on Sionna reference data to generate multi-user TR 38.901 wireless channels faster than the simulator while preserving geometry-dependent spatial correlations. It separates large-scale power from PCA-compressed small-scale fading in a latent generative model.

entry.title: Condition-Stratified Robustness Analysis of Post-Hoc Calibration Methods for Probabilistic Classifiers

author.name: Gurdeep Singh Virdee

entry.summary: Conducts a preregistered, condition-stratified robustness comparison of temperature scaling versus isotonic regression across four operating conditions, testing discrimination, Brier score, calibration slope, and AUROC with multiplicity control. It examines whether aggregate calibration performance holds within distinct sub-conditions.

entry.title: Privacy-Aware Collaborative and Distributed Bayesian Optimization

author.name: Aditya Rane, Sathwik Yamana, Paritosh Ramanan, Srikanthan Ramesh, Akash Deep

entry.summary: Presents a collaborative meta-learning framework for distributed Bayesian optimization that matches centralized performance without raw-data exchange, shows gradient sharing leaks client observations (worsening near the optimum), and evaluates a differentially private defense with its privacy-utility trade-off. It highlights privacy risks in collaborative optimization.

entry.title: A multi-scale feature enhanced graph neural network for fluid dynamics prediction in complex geometries

author.name: Li Xiao, Tianyu Li, Yiye Zou, Mingjie Zhang, Xiaogangd Deng

entry.summary: Proposes ME-GNN, a multi-scale feature-enhanced graph neural network with two-step message passing to predict fluid dynamics on complex geometries and large unstructured meshes, aiming to reduce costly numerical simulation. It targets industrial design in vehicle and aerospace engineering.

entry.title: Toward Efficient Weakly Supervised Semantic Segmentation Using Only Low-Magnification Histopathological Images

author.name: Dung Minh Do, Nhat-Thanh Huynh, Duc Minh Huynh, Doanh C. Bui, Khang Nguyen

entry.summary: Presents a benchmark study on whether low-magnification histopathology images with only image-level labels can match high-magnification performance for weakly supervised semantic segmentation. It simulates lower-magnification inputs from high-resolution patches to compare storage settings.

entry.title: Reference-Based Face Super-Resolution Using the Spatial Transformer

author.name: Varun Ramesh Jois, Antonella DiLillo, James Storer

entry.summary: Presents a reference-based face super-resolution method using a spatial-transformer alignment module that is more stable than deformable convolutions, plus an aggregation function that draws detail from reference images or suppresses them when poor. It addresses the ill-posed nature of adding fine facial detail.

entry.title: Do Transformer Temporal Heads and Post-Pooling Motion Gates Help CorrNet-based CSLR? An Empirical Study

author.name: Lisi Wang, Zhidong Xiao, Jianjun Peng

entry.summary: Empirically studies two extensions to the CorrNet baseline for continuous sign language recognition: replacing the BiLSTM head with a Transformer and adding a post-pooling motion gate. It finds the Transformer head does not beat BiLSTM and the motion gate collapses to an identity mapping.

entry.title: ScratNet: A Swin-Based Multi-Scale Dilated Network with Precision Refinement for Semiconductor Scratch Segmentation

author.name: Sachin Ranjan, Hoon Kim

entry.summary: Presents ScratNet, a Swin-Transformer-based multi-scale dilated segmentation network with precision refinement for detecting low-contrast, irregular scratch defects in semiconductor manufacturing. It combines dilated aggregation and stem-integration modules to capture fine edge details.

entry.title: Geometry-aware Gaussian Prior and Axial Attention for Cervical Cytology Image Classification

author.name: Yating Li, Cheng Ye, Nenan Lyu, Weidong Chen, Zhendong Mao

entry.summary: Proposes a geometry-aware framework combining a Gaussian prior and axial attention for cervical cytology image classification, aiming to model both local texture and long-range structure across the Pap-smear taxonomy. It addresses subtle intra-class variation and strong inter-class similarity of cervical cells.

entry.title: Benchmarking UAV-based Vehicle Re-Identification under Simulated Weather Conditions

author.name: Vu Minh Tran, Khang Nguyen

entry.summary: Provides a controlled comparative study of recent UAV-based vehicle re-identification methods under simulated adverse weather, evaluating robustness to conditions that degrade fine-grained aerial appearance cues. It highlights an insufficiently studied robustness gap for aerial ReID.

entry.title: Anomalous Frame Detection by Grouping Frame Similarities between Two Videos Computed by Vision-Language Model to Extract Expert Workers' Unique Actions

author.name: Ryo Sakai, Yongpeng Cao, Nobutaka Kimura

entry.summary: Proposes a method to detect anomalous frames capturing expert know-how by grouping frame similarities between a manual-based work video and an expert worker's video using a vision-language model. It targets transfer of tacit maintenance skills that experts may not consciously articulate.

entry.title: DP-Splat: Bayesian Nonparametric Complexity Control for Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Aqi Dong

entry.summary: DP-Splat replaces the fixed component count in Variational Bayes Gaussian Splatting with a truncated stick-breaking Dirichlet-process prior so the number of occupied Gaussians adapts to the data via closed-form coordinate ascent. A natural-gradient variant makes per-step cost independent of point count.

entry.title: Confidence Scores in Open-Vocabulary Detection Are a Biased Mixture of Scale and Semantics

author.name: Yi Tang Soon, Jun-Wei Hsieh

entry.summary: This analysis shows that confidence scores from open-vocabulary detectors like GroundingDINO, OWL-ViT, and YOLO-World are a biased mixture of visual scale and semantic query specificity rather than reliable localization probabilities. Controlled experiments on COCO and LVIS quantify statistically significant scale and semantic biases.

entry.title: WiFi-JEPA: Self-supervised Learning for WiFi-CSI 3D Human Pose Estimation

author.name: Doeon Kim, Jungyoon Lee, Seongsin Kim, Seong-heum Kim

entry.summary: WiFi-JEPA is a self-supervised framework that learns CSI-native representations for WiFi-based 3D human pose estimation by predicting masked latent embeddings rather than reconstructing raw signals. It introduces CSI-specific tokenization and antenna-link masking to capture cross-link correlations and improve robustness to environment shifts.

entry.title: SLVMBench: Skill Learning from Video Memory

author.name: Yudong Yang, Guangzhi Sun, Yixuan Li, Chao Zhang

entry.summary: SLVMBench is the first benchmark evaluating whether video LLMs can learn a skill from a tutorial embedded in a 2-3 hour stream of irrelevant videos and then apply it to real-time questions. It tests the full pipeline of memorizing, extracting, and applying procedural knowledge from long video memory.

entry.title: Cycle-World: Mitigating Error Accumulation in Long-term Video World Models via Reverse-Prediction Cycle Consistency

author.name: Zihan Su, Teng Hu, Jiangning Zhang, Ruiyan Wang, Ran Yi, Lizhuang Ma, Dacheng Tao

entry.summary: Cycle-World mitigates error accumulation in long-horizon autoregressive video world models by enforcing strict temporal reversibility across training and inference via a reverse-prediction cycle-consistency objective. The authors theoretically show that forward generative drift can be bottlenecked by cycle consistency, improving long-video stability.

entry.title: HASTE: A Platform for Rapid Post-Disaster Building Damage Assessment

author.name: Caleb Robinson, Anthony Ortiz, Simone Fobi Nsutezo, Cameron Birge, Meygha Machado, Marcelo Duarte, Joaquin Rivero Rodriguez, Anthony Cintron Roman, Kevin White, Inbal Becker-Reshef, Juan M. Lavista Ferres

entry.summary: HASTE is a no-code web platform from Microsoft researchers that lets non-ML analysts produce per-building damage maps from post-disaster satellite imagery within hours, without requiring matched before-and-after imagery or similar past-event training data. It offers two methods sharing one interface for rapid emergency response.

entry.title: PrismAD: Decoupled Planning via Semantic Mixture-of-Planners for End-to-End Autonomous Driving

author.name: Kang Ding, Zhigui Lin, Hongsong Wang, Jie Gui, Qi Liu, Zhe Wang, Luqi Tang, Lei He

entry.summary: PrismAD is an end-to-end autonomous driving planner that decouples scene reasoning by splitting tokens into interaction, geometry, and intent groups, each handled by a dedicated planning expert with a semantic router. The mixture-of-planners design aims to improve factor-specific reasoning over coupled representations.

entry.title: Plug-and-Play Reweighting for Resilient Collaborative Decision-Making in Connected Autonomous Driving

author.name: Jiewen Liu, Rui Liu, Matthew Lee, Ming C. Lin, Xiaorui Liu, Peng Gao

entry.summary: Proposes RCDM, a plug-and-play attention-based reweighting framework for resilient collaborative decision-making among connected autonomous vehicles under perceptual noise and adversarial attacks, avoiding attack-specific retraining. It fuses collaborator perceptions robustly at decision time.

entry.title: Millimeter Wave Radar: From Synthetic Aperture to Probabilistic Mapping

author.name: Jui-Te Huang, Ruoyang Xu, Michael Kaess

entry.summary: Establishes a full pipeline from raw millimeter-wave radar signals to probabilistic occupancy maps, combining synthetic aperture radar processing with probabilistic modeling for robust mapping in smoke and fog. Validated across indoor environments where optical sensors fail.

entry.title: D-SafeMPC: Diffusion-Driven Safe Model Predictive Control with Discrete-Time Control Barrier Functions

author.name: Erdi Sayar, Ersin Da\c{s}, Joel W. Burdick, Alois Knoll, Erdal Kayacan

entry.summary: D-SafeMPC couples diffusion-based trajectory generation with model predictive control by guiding the reverse diffusion with control barrier and Lyapunov functions and refining trajectories through an iterative-projection MPC scheme. It aims to enforce safety and dynamical feasibility that diffusion models lack.

entry.title: Wearing A Coat: Dual-Arm Robot-Assisted Dressing with Differentiable Clothing Simulation

author.name: Yiming Liu, Lijun Han, Hesheng Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a dual-arm robot-assisted dressing controller that integrates real-time differentiable clothing simulation using an explicit iterative scheme with higher-order perturbations for efficiency. It handles partially worn garments under contact constraints, which segment-based methods struggle with.

entry.title: GeoGS-SLAM: Online Monocular Reconstruction Using Gaussian Splatting with Geometric Priors

author.name: Ruilan Gao, Letian Jin, Yu Zhang

entry.summary: GeoGS-SLAM is an online monocular dense reconstruction system that combines 3D Gaussian Splatting map representation with learned geometric priors from a feed-forward visual geometry model, retaining RGB information during optimization. It works from uncalibrated RGB input without external depth sensors.

entry.title: EDAR: Learning Environment-Dependent Action Representations for Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Yuecheng Xu, Tong Yang, Jingkai Jia, Chi Zhang, Xuelong Li, Wenqiang Zhang

entry.summary: EDAR proposes environment-dependent action representations that ground action tokens in both executable control structure and expected visual consequences, recognizing that the same action induces different outcomes under different scenes. It couples motor commands with environment-conditioned effects for better manipulation modeling.

entry.title: ERR@HRI 3.0 Challenge: Multimodal Detection of Errors and Anticipation in Human-Robot Interactions

author.name: Maria Teresa Parreira, Micol Spitale, Maia Stiber, Shiye Cao, Amama Mahmood, Chien-Ming Huang, Hatice Gunes, Wendy Ju

entry.summary: The ERR@HRI 3.0 Challenge provides two datasets with raw non-anonymized video to enable end-to-end multimodal detection and anticipation of errors in human-robot interaction, moving beyond context-specific or pre-extracted-feature approaches. It aims to improve generalizable error detection for maintaining user trust.

entry.title: Automated Synthesis of Facial Mechanisms for Conversational Animatronic Robots

author.name: Zongzheng Zhang, Zi Lin, Jiawen Yang, Ziqiao Peng, Junyan Lao, Lin Cheng, Huazhe Xu, Hang Zhao, Hao Zhao

entry.summary: Pursues automated, scalable synthesis of animatronic facial mechanisms by introducing a parametric linkage-driven mechanical face template whose topology and actuator layout are parameterized to retarget across diverse facial geometries. It aims to replace slow manual redesign for personalized socially interactive robot faces.

entry.title: GNet: A scalable and flexible Gaussian process network with nonparametric neurons

author.name: Mengyang Gu

entry.summary: Develops GNet, a scalable Gaussian process network with nonparametric activation functions modeled by Gaussian processes, plus a jointly inverse Kalman filter for fast training without forming covariance matrices. It shows competitive performance across nonlinear regression and high-dimensional physics tasks.

entry.title: 5 "Plan A" scenarios

author.name: Dave Orr

entry.summary: Building on the AI 2040 Plan A scenario, Dave Orr brainstorms additional governance and verification levers, such as chip-level compute control with integrated training-detection monitoring and remote killswitches enforced at fabs. It expands the space of layered defenses across governance, verification, and incentives.

entry.title: Heterogeneous Agent Cohorts for Safe Open-Ended Exploration with Runtime Constraint Memory

author.name: Tengjiao Liu

entry.summary: Separates creativity and caution across specialized agent roles (Disrupter, Validator, Broker) for safe open-ended exploration, compiling repeated failures into reusable signed constraint patches called Scars via MCTS. Aims to balance exploration with runtime safety enforcement.

entry.title: Beyond the Eye: Efficient Multimodal Reasoning via Self-Regulated Implicit Visual Tools

author.name: Xiuwei Chen, Quanlin Chen, Wentao Hu, Zisheng Chen, Kun Xiang, Zehua Ma, Mingyang Zhang, Jianhua Han, Hanhui Li, Hang Xu, Xiaodan Liang

entry.summary: BEE is an implicit visual tool paradigm for multimodal LLMs that incorporates visual tool invocation into the training objective so the model self-regulates when to invoke tools, reducing repeated external calls and image re-encoding. It aims to cut the computational overhead of the Thinking-with-Images approach while preserving fine-grained perception.

entry.title: When Depth Is Better Told Than Shown: Depth-Ordinal Prompting for Vision-Language Spatial Reasoning

author.name: Quynh Vo, Phuc Dao, Cong-Duy Nguyen, Thong Nguyen

entry.summary: Depth-Ordinal Prompting is a training-free method that converts monocular depth into a single question-targeted ordinal text cue rather than feeding a depth map to VLMs, which the authors show can hurt performance. It improves spatial reasoning by making depth accessible as language rather than as a noisy auxiliary image.

entry.title: HyperGS: Fast and Generalizable Gaussian Video Representation

author.name: Fatimah Zohra, Chen Zhao, Shuming Liu, Yahya Al Malallah, Bernard Ghanem

entry.summary: HyperGS is a feed-forward, optimization-free approach that directly predicts Gaussian representations for video in a single forward pass, drastically speeding up encoding and decoding while generalizing to out-of-distribution and higher-resolution videos. It uses a factorized spatiotemporal transformer and a query-based transformer to produce compact 8-parameter Gaussians per frame.

entry.title: Slide-Level Active Learning Reduces Annotation Burden in H&E images

author.name: Mahsa Vali, Zhilong Weng, No\'emie Moreaua, Yuri Tolkach, Katarzyna Bozek

entry.summary: Proposes SHAL, a slide-level hybrid active learning framework that reduces annotation burden for multi-class histopathology segmentation by addressing unreliable uncertainty, patch-slide mismatch, and class imbalance. Aims to align acquisition with real pathology annotation workflows.

entry.title: Task Planning for Mobile Manipulation in Retail Stores using Foundation Models with Iterative Re-planning

author.name: Vismay Vakharia, Sanjana Garai, Rolif Lima, Nijil George, Vighnesh Vatsal, Kaushik Das

entry.summary: Uses LLMs and VLMs for task planning with iterative re-planning to solve retail shelf restocking with a custom omnidirectional mobile manipulator. Demonstrates foundation-model-driven mobile manipulation in variable, human-centric store environments.

entry.title: Diffusion-Residual Model Predictive Steering Control for Vehicle Stabilization at the Limit of Handling under Model Uncertainty

author.name: Bongsob Song

entry.summary: Introduces a diffusion-residual MPC for vehicle stabilization at the limit of handling that learns model uncertainty with a conditional diffusion residual model and applies it to the controller reference and constraints rather than the control law. The learned mean re-sizes the yaw reference while the spread tightens the stable envelope.

entry.title: Real-Time Rulebook-Aware Nonlinear MPC for Autonomous Driving with Priority-Biased Tiered Slacks

author.name: Hadi Hajieghrary, Benedikt Walter, Chaitanya Shinde, Paul Schmitt, Miguel Hurtado

entry.summary: W-SQP is a weighted tiered-slack nonlinear MPC for autonomous driving that compiles nine driving-rule families into a four-tier shared-slack program solved online, biasing residual violations toward lower-priority rules while keeping actuation bounds hard. It records per-rule residuals each cycle for auditability under a 90 ms solver limit.

entry.title: A Formal Hierarchical Architecture for Agentic Orchestration with Stack-Based Execution and Lazy Discovery

author.name: Prashant Devadiga, Abhishek, Adithya Mishra, Alok Singh, Amisha Sinha, Asit Desai, Gaurang Dahad, Harshit Bhushan, Mandati Pramod Reddy, Prakhar Gupta, Rupesh Patil, Siddhi Behere

entry.summary: Proposes a hierarchical, skill-based orchestration architecture for LLM agents that organizes tools as a rooted tree with routing internal nodes and deterministic leaf nodes, using a LIFO stack and lazy discovery to avoid decision-space explosion. Targets context-window saturation with large tool registries.

entry.title: AutoVSR: Automatic Visual-to-Symbolic Reasoning for Symbolic Expression Generation from Circuit Schematic

author.name: Zhe Xiao, Longfei Li, Xu He, Haoying Wu, Zixing Zhang, Mingyu Liu

entry.summary: Proposes AutoVSR, a framework using vision-language models plus a symbolic solver to derive symbolic expressions from circuit schematics by reconstructing diagrams into an executable intermediate representation. Aims to improve accuracy of multi-step symbolic derivation from images.

entry.title: StructAgent: Harness Long-horizon Digital Agents with Unified Causal Structure

author.name: Wenyi Wu, Sibo Zhu, Kun Zhou, Aayush Salvi, Zixuan Song, Biwei Huang

entry.summary: Wait duplicate id note removed.

entry.title: Infrared Organization and Critical Cognitive Field Formation in Transformer Dynamics

author.name: Byung Gyu Chae

entry.summary: Applies a Cognitive Field Theory framework to extract relaxation spectra from Pythia transformer layer Jacobians across training and scale, quantifying time-scale density of states and an infrared critical exponent to describe collective learning dynamics. It attempts a statistical-physics account of emergent LLM behavior.

entry.title: AeroMELD: A Linear Embedding of Aerosol Populations for Diagnostics and Latent Dynamics

author.name: Ehsan Saleh, Saba Ghaffari, Wenhan Tang, Jeffrey H. Curtis, Lekha Patel, Peter A. Bosler, Nicole Riemer, Matthew West

entry.summary: Introduces AeroMELD, a mathematically grounded linear embedding of atmospheric aerosol populations that preserves their measure-theoretic structure to support physically meaningful process operators and latent dynamics. It improves reduced representations for aerosol-cloud and radiative modeling.

entry.title: A Novel Graph Fraud Detector via Grouped Attribute Completion and Confidence-Aware Contrastive Learning

author.name: Junpeng Wu, Ye Yuan

entry.summary: Presents GFD-GC, a graph fraud detection framework using grouped attribute completion to fill incomplete node features and confidence-aware contrastive learning to handle extreme class imbalance. It targets robustness of GNN-based detectors in real digital ecosystems.

entry.title: MVMGNN;Multi-View Masked Graph Neural Network for Alzheimer's Disease Diagnosis using Structural MRI

author.name: Ni Yao, Zhenxu Wang, Danyang Sun, Chuang Han, Yanting Li, Jiaofen Nan, Fubao Zhu, Chen Zhao, Weihua Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-view masked graph neural network combining multiple brain-network construction strategies from structural MRI for Alzheimer's and mild cognitive impairment diagnosis. It jointly captures spatial and morphological relationships between brain regions.

entry.title: Depth-Efficient Quantum Topological Data Analysis for Regime-Specific Detection of Financial Stress

author.name: Arul Rhik Mazumder, Shreyan Ronit Mazumder

entry.summary: Adapts Pauli Correlation Encoding to quantum topological data analysis, reformulating Betti number estimation as a depth-efficient variational optimization on a compressed qubit register. It applies this to detect financial stress regimes in S&P 500 data.

entry.title: BiLoG-Net: A Bi-Context Location-Guided Network for Breast Mass Segmentation and Malignancy Classification in Mammography

author.name: Abu Fatema Mohammad Abdun Noor, Md Imam Ahasan, Md Samiul Ahasan, Kah Ong Michael Goh, S M Hasan Mahmud, Raihana Zannat

entry.summary: Proposes BiLoG-Net, a deep learning framework that jointly segments breast masses and classifies malignancy in mammography using bi-context location-aware features and segmentation-guided attention. It targets subtle intensity variations and indistinct lesion boundaries.

entry.title: Toward Production-Ready Federated Learning in Healthcare: Privacy, Orchestration, and Governance in MLOps

author.name: Sakshi Gorkhali, Jonesh Shrestha

entry.summary: Examines how MLOps practices and an emerging notion of Federated Learning Operations can make privacy-preserving federated healthcare ML production-ready, covering orchestration, monitoring, rollback, and governance. It stresses that federated learning is not private or deployable by default.

entry.title: From Patent Expiry to Business Pathways: AI Workflows for Activating Innovation Archives

author.name: Sidney Shapiro, Mark Price

entry.summary: Proposes an AI-enabled framework to discover expired or lapsing patents, detect technology trends, and translate patent disclosures into structured commercialization pathways such as products, services, or licensing packages. It reframes patent expiry as a business and archival signal rather than a purely legal event.

entry.title: A Generalized Deep Non-negative Matrix Factorization Approach for SAR Automatic Target Recognition

author.name: Yunhong Zhang, Changjie Cao, Zhongli Zhou, Bingli Liu, Zongjie Cao, Zongyong Cui, Ying Yang

entry.summary: Proposes G-DNMF, a generalized deep non-negative matrix factorization method for SAR automatic target recognition that pursues global optimality to avoid the error accumulation of layer-by-layer decomposition. It aims to improve both interpretability and recognition accuracy for radar targets.

entry.title: Mixture of Cognitive Experts in Large Vision-Language Models

author.name: Robert Wijaya, Ngai-Man Cheung

entry.summary: This work proposes a mixture-of-cognitive-experts design that integrates specialized domain-specific vision models as perceptual subsystems into large vision-language models to improve verifiability and reduce hallucinations. The aim is a coherent, interpretable multi-encoder representation spanning different cognitive levels.

entry.title: Learning Anatomy-Grounded CT Vision-Language Representations with Organ-Hierarchical Report Knowledge

author.name: Guoliang You, Hongming Li, Yuanwang Zhang, Yong Fan

entry.summary: OKA-CT is an organ-hierarchical knowledge-augmented framework for CT-report vision-language pretraining that structures free-text reports into organ-conditioned knowledge using report parsing and LLM-assisted semantic structuring. This hierarchy is used to better align image regions with organ-organized findings.

entry.title: AsySplat: Efficient Asymmetric 3D Gaussian Splatting for Long-Sequence Scene Modeling

author.name: Yingji Zhong, Dave Zhenyu Chen, Fuzhao Ou, Youyu Chen, Zhihao Li, Lanqing Hong, Dan Xu

entry.summary: AsySplat reduces redundant computation in generalizable 3DGS for long sequences using an asymmetric architecture that decouples geometry and appearance modeling. A heavy geometry branch on coarse tokens handles multi-view reconstruction while a lightweight appearance branch on fine tokens captures details.

entry.title: Why Low-Light Cameras Go Color Blind: Removing Color Bias in Raw Denoising

author.name: Mohammad Mohammadi, Sina Honari, Stavros Tsogkas, Tristan Aumentado-Armstrong, Michael S. Brown, Iqbal Mohomed, Konstantinos G. Derpanis, Alex Levinshtein, Igor Gilitschenski

entry.summary: This work presents a camera-agnostic, calibration-free approach to low-light raw denoising, identifying and removing a color bias that causes low-light cameras to lose color accuracy. It avoids reliance on costly noisy-clean pairs or precise per-device noise calibration.

entry.title: Slot-RAE: Streamlining Object-Centric Learning via Direct Representation Auto-Encoders

author.name: Alexandre Chapin (LIRIS), Emmanuel Dellandrea (LIRIS), Liming Chen (LIRIS)

entry.summary: Slot-RAE is a simplified object-centric learning framework that operates directly in the continuous semantic feature space of visual foundation models like DINOv3, using a Diffusion Transformer decoder and a representation-alignment head. It avoids heavy pretrained generative priors and external VAE latent spaces used by prior diffusion-based methods.

entry.title: DynEval: Holistic Evaluations of T2I Generative Models in the Wild

author.name: Shyam Marjit, Dheeraj Baiju, Anuj Shikarkhane, Akhil Sakthieswaran, Sayak Paul, Anirban Chakraborty

entry.summary: DynEval is a dynamic evaluation framework for text-to-image models that jointly assesses prompt alignment and image quality, backed by two large datasets including a 500K prompt-image collection. It aims to capture subtle failure modes like partial misalignment and compositional errors that static-prompt evaluators miss.

entry.title: SalientGS: Unified SfM-to-3DGS with Importance-Guided MCMC Gaussian Allocation

author.name: Tianyu Xiong, Rui Li, Suning Ge, Jiaqi Yang

entry.summary: SalientGS is a unified Structure-from-Motion-to-3DGS pipeline whose central contribution is importance-guided MCMC Gaussian allocation that reallocates capacity toward underfit regions using multi-view residual signals. It achieves end-to-end reconstruction in about 15 minutes with state-of-the-art quality.

entry.title: Motion4Motion: Motion Transfer Across Subjects at Inference

author.name: Ling-Hao Chen, Zixin Yin, Duomin Wang, Xianfang Zeng, Gang Yu

entry.summary: Motion4Motion transfers motion from one video to another at inference without relying on a predefined human skeleton structure or skeleton-conditional model training, enabling generalization to diverse characters including different animal species. This overcomes limitations of skeleton-dependent pipelines and scarce labeled cross-skeleton data.

entry.title: GFR-SAM: Training-Free Referring Camouflaged Object Segmentation via Cross-Image Prompting

author.name: Yilong Yang, Jianxin Tian, Shengchuan Zhang, Liujuan Cao

entry.summary: GFR-SAM is a training-free three-stage generate-filter-refine framework for referring camouflaged object segmentation that uses in-context exemplar-guided segmentation to give SAM3 cross-image inference, DINOv3-based prototypical filtering, and refinement. It shifts from fragile point-matching to a more robust cross-image prompting paradigm.

entry.title: PoseAlign: Sculpting Pose-Consistent Meshes via Text-Guided Deformation

author.name: Shijin Wang, Zichong Chen, Yang Zhou, Hui Huang

entry.summary: PoseAlign performs text-guided 3D mesh deformation in two stages, global pose scaling using a differentiable Laplacian representation and local detail sculpting with a novel pose-aligned score distillation loss. It targets deforming meshes to match prompts while preserving pose.

entry.title: Navigating the Crowd: Non-linear MPC with Social Forces Dynamics for Human-Aware Robot Navigation

author.name: Stefano Trepella, Andrea Ostuni, Mauro Martini, Pablo Pueyo, No\'e P\'erez-Higueras, Marcello Chiaberge, Fernando Caballero, Luis Merino

entry.summary: SFM-NMPC embeds the Social Force Model directly into a nonlinear MPC optimization loop so the controller jointly predicts human motion and plans socially compliant, collision-free robot navigation through crowds. It integrates prediction and control instead of treating them separately.

entry.title: Large Language Model Enhanced Differentiable Trajectory Planning for IoT-Enabled Autonomous Driving

author.name: Shihao Zhang, Jing Yang, Ziyu Song, Zheng Lin, Sunil Prajapat, Zhaochen Xia, Hemant Ghayvat, Haitao Ding, Lip Yee Por, Ashok Kumar Das

entry.summary: Proposes an LLM-enhanced differentiable trajectory planning framework for IoT-connected autonomous driving that injects high-level scene semantics to improve coverage of long-tail interactions and consistency with downstream constrained refinement. It targets safe, executable trajectories under real-time constraints.

entry.title: Learning Roller-Skating Motions of Humanoid Robots Based on Adversarial Motion Priors

author.name: Yunkang Cheng, Yutong Wu, Menghan Li, Shihe Zhou, Mingguo Zhao

entry.summary: Presents an adversarial motion prior reinforcement learning framework that teaches humanoid robots two roller-skating gaits (Pump Glide and Push Glide) from separately motion-captured, retargeted references. Each gait uses independent policies and reward architectures for whole-body balance on rolling contacts.

entry.title: Requirement-Driven Design of Whole-Body Social Tactile Sensing via Virtual Human-Robot Interaction

author.name: Dakarai Crowder, Ruohan Zhang, Alexis E. Block, Wenzhen Yuan

entry.summary: Introduces a requirement-driven framework that derives whole-body social tactile sensing requirements (spatial resolution and placement) directly from VR-collected interaction data rather than predefined hardware layouts. It yields an open-source dataset of 5,520 trials across nine recurring social touch gestures.

entry.title: A Compact Top-Loading Robot for Endovascular Interventions: Design, Control and Evaluation

author.name: Jonas Fischer, Lennart Karstensen, Franziska Mathis-Ullrich

entry.summary: Presents a compact top-loading robotic system for endovascular interventions using two alternating carts with pneumatic membrane grippers to continuously translate and rotate standard catheter instruments. It aims to reduce surgeon radiation exposure and improve clinical workflow integration for vascular procedures.

entry.title: Learning to control switching nonlinear systems with Koopman operator regression

author.name: Edoardo Caldarelli, Oleksii Kachaiev, Cesare Molinari, Lorenzo Rosasco

entry.summary: Studies identification and control of switching nonlinear systems using Koopman operator regression in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space, yielding a linear switching predictive model used in model predictive control. It derives learning rates and sub-optimality bounds for the resulting controller.

entry.title: What building Shippy taught us about building agents

author.name: Unknown

entry.summary: An Ai2 engineering post on lessons from building Shippy, arguing that reliable AI agents depend less on the underlying model than on deterministic tools, explicit guardrails, isolated infrastructure, and evaluations grounded in real workflows and live data. It offers practical agent-building guidance.

entry.title: Verifier-Guided Twelve-Tone Composition: A Generate-Verify-Repair Harness for Symbolic Music Generation

author.name: Congren Dai, Danni Zhao, Enyang Liu, Michael Ching Yam, Zhancheng Guo, Siyi Gu, Wentao Yang, Bo Dai, Xiaobing Li, Maosong Sun

entry.summary: Introduces a neuro-symbolic generate-verify-repair harness that wraps a language-model proposer with symbolic verification for twelve-tone composition, improving audited delivery yield from about 13 to 48 percent while abstaining otherwise. Blinded expert evaluation is included.

entry.title: MAC-Splat: Multi-Attribute Consistency for High-Fidelity Sparse-View Reconstruction

author.name: Jinqian Yang, Yichen Wu, Wanhua Li, Haokun Lin, Renzhen Wang, Xiangchu Feng, Xixi Jia

entry.summary: MAC-Splat improves sparse-view 3D Gaussian Splatting by adding direct 3D consistency supervision built on the MASt3R geometric backbone and a frozen DINOv3 encoder for semantically informed correspondences. It introduces a Multi-Attribute Consistency loss to resolve the depth and correspondence ambiguities that photometric-only losses leave unaddressed.

entry.title: X-GuideAR: An Augmented Reality Framework to Mitigate Radiation Exposure during Fluoroscopic Guidance

author.name: Mingxu Liu, Zixuan Liu, Ruchen Cai, Yu-Chen Ku, Suxi Gu, Amit Jain, Alejandro Martin-Gomez, Mehran Armand

entry.summary: X-GuideAR is an augmented reality framework that generates synthetic X-ray previews to reduce fluoroscopic radiation exposure during orthopedic screw placement, demonstrated on S2 alar-iliac screws. It guides view acquisition and drilling before a confirming real X-ray is taken.

entry.title: Metadata Supervised MRI Representations for Modelling and Controlling Acquisition Variability

author.name: Mehmet Yigit Avci, Pedro Borges, Virginia Fernandez, Natalia Glazman, Paul Wright, Mehmet Yigitsoy, Sebastien Ourselin, Jorge Cardoso

entry.summary: This work jointly models MRI images and DICOM metadata to learn representations that disentangle anatomical structure from scanner- and protocol-dependent appearance. The resulting contrast representations organize heterogeneous acquisitions and detect image-metadata inconsistencies, improving interpretability and generalization.

entry.title: Higher-Order Cell Tracking Transformer

author.name: Jord\~ao Bragantini, Ilan Theodoro, Lo\"ic A. Royer

entry.summary: The Higher-Order Cell Tracking Transformer is an edge-centric architecture for reconstructing cell lineages from live-imaging microscopy that lets candidate cell links attend to one another, addressing how cell divisions entangle lineage paths and how candidate-graph edges carry little label information. It reframes tracking around higher-order relationships between candidate links rather than nodes.

entry.title: Beyond the Single Camera: Agentic Multi-View Reasoning in Sports Video Understanding

author.name: Kerui Chen, Jinglu Wang, Xiaoyi Zhang, Yan Lu

entry.summary: SportMV-Bench is a benchmark for multi-view sports video understanding built from official match recordings using a pipeline of LLM-based generation, MLLM-based verification, and human filtering, addressing the absence of multi-view evaluation for MLLMs. It targets scenarios with dense occlusion, rapid motion, and complex interactions unresolvable from a single viewpoint.

entry.title: Efficient and Robust Spiking Neural Networks for sEMG-Based Muscle Fatigue Detection

author.name: Kaiwen Tang, Jiaqi Dong, Zhanglu Yan, Weng-Fai Wong

entry.summary: Proposes an energy-efficient spiking neural network framework for muscle fatigue detection from surface EMG, using sparse event-driven computation and a quantization-compatible training scheme. Targets low-cost wearable health monitoring where standard deep models are too expensive.

entry.title: Learning High-Level Decision Making with an Interaction-Aware Attention-Based Network in Autonomous Driving

author.name: Marcelo Contreras, Willi Poh, Christoph Stiller, Ehsan Hashemi

entry.summary: Introduces DecisionPerceiver, a Perceiver-IO-inspired attention architecture that projects variable numbers of dynamic agents into a fixed-size latent for high-level lane-change and speed decisions, explicitly modeling traffic interactions with bounded complexity. Targets negotiation-intensive scenarios like intersections.

entry.title: Breaking the 15% Barrier: A Real-World Data-Driven System for Proactive Social Robot Triggered by User Nonverbal Cues

author.name: Yuga Yano, Yuki Okafuji, Ryo Miyoshi, Sanae Yamashita, Yoshiki Ohira

entry.summary: Studies real-world retail robot interactions and finds that 15.3 percent of robot utterances over a 6-day deployment were triggered by customers' nonverbal cues (approaching, waving, pointing) rather than speech, exposing a limitation of audio-only STT-LLM-TTS pipelines. It defines service-relevant nonverbal cues to enable proactive social robots.

entry.title: The Individual-Targeting Assumption: A Systematic Review of Proactive Robots in Human Group Settings

author.name: Tauhid Tanjim, Tasmia Mayen, Malte F. Jung, Susan R. Fussell

entry.summary: A systematic review of 63 proactive human-robot interaction studies in group settings finds a recurring Individual-Targeting Assumption where robots treat co-present people as independent targets rather than as members of cohesive social groups. It argues most designs ignore relational group structure.

entry.title: NextFund: A Unified Performance Tracking Platform for Agentic Portfolio Management

author.name: Changlun Li, Peixian Ma, Qiqi Duan, Zhenyu Lin, Peineng Wu

entry.summary: Introduces NextFund, an evaluation platform that makes financial-agent behavior observable under live market conditions by logging the full decision path from analyst judgments to execution. Aims to move beyond static exams and terminal-return reporting.

entry.title: Trustworthy synthetic data for campaign decision support: strategy simulation fidelity and the PolicySynth framework

author.name: Tung Dang, The Hung Phung, Son Lam Nguyen, Tu Nguyen

entry.summary: Introduces strategy simulation fidelity, a criterion measuring whether synthetic customer data lead managers to the same go/no-go campaign decisions as real data, plus the PolicySynth framework to close the decision-alignment gap left by distributional-similarity metrics. It targets trustworthy synthetic data for decision support.

entry.title: A Risk-Field Enhanced Closed-Loop Digital Twin Framework for Autonomous Driving Safety Validation

author.name: Yongzhi Liu

entry.summary: Proposes a risk-field enhanced closed-loop digital twin framework connecting physical traffic data, virtual reconstruction, and scenario evolution for autonomous driving safety validation. It aims to expose rare safety-critical scenarios more efficiently than road testing.

entry.title: CHM-Net: Center Heatmap-driven Macro-Micro Modeling Network for MRI-based Microbial Density Stratification

author.name: Jiaming Liang, Haolin Chen, Tingting Li, Bowen Yu, Qianyan Long, Tinghe Zhang, Xi Zhong, Xiaowei Hu, Xiaoqi Sheng, Hongmin Cai

entry.summary: Introduces a center heatmap-driven network for inferring microbial density from multimodal MRI, framed as a patient-level representation learning task for tumor assessment. It localizes small lesions before aggregating macro-micro evidence.

entry.title: Artificial Intelligence Across the Cardiac Amyloidosis Diagnostic Pathway: From Single-Modality Detection to Multimodal Clinical Integration

author.name: Diana Shadibaeva, Rochak Dhakal, Kui Zhang, Xiaofeng Yang, Saurabh Malhotra, Weihua Zhou

entry.summary: A narrative review synthesizing AI applications across the cardiac amyloidosis diagnostic pathway, spanning ECG, echocardiography, CMR, and nuclear imaging by clinical task. It highlights the shift from single-modality detection toward multimodal clinical integration.

entry.title: Projection-Domain Sensitivity Analysis of Vertebral DRRs Under Intrinsic Calibration Perturbation

author.name: Lin Li, Chaochao Zhou, Benjamin Aubert, Junlin Guo, Junchao Zhu

entry.summary: Presents a synthetic framework analyzing how intrinsic calibration perturbations propagate into vertebral fluoroscopic projections and downstream 2D-3D registration performance. It uses CT-derived vertebral models and controlled cone-beam geometry to isolate calibration effects.

entry.title: End-to-End Real-Time Drone-Based Person Detection Framework Using Deep Learning

author.name: Payel Sarmah, Ayush Ranjan, Piyush Kaushik Bhattacharyya, Anil Kr. Shaw, Pradip Kr. Das

entry.summary: Proposes a real-time drone-based person detection pipeline built on a lightweight YOLOv8-nano model for wireless live video, characterizing detection performance across multiple flight altitudes. It targets search-and-rescue and surveillance applications where scale varies with altitude.

entry.title: Not All Color Categories Are Equally Stable: A Multilingual Free Color Naming Experiment

author.name: Nuray Toganas, Adilet Yerkin, Elnara Kadyrgali, Muragul Muratbekova, Aron Karatayev, Pakizar Shamoi

entry.summary: Reports a free color-naming experiment with 92 participants examining the consistency of red, yellow, and green categories across shades using samples from the COLIBRI dataset. It finds that some color categories remain stable while others shift naming with changes in saturation and brightness.

entry.title: Align and Segment: Unsupervised Learning for Building Segmentation From Misaligned Labels

author.name: Venkanna Babu Guthula, Oswin Krause, Dimitri Gominski, Hui Zhang, Johan Mottelson, Ankit Kariryaa, Nico Lang, Christian Igel

entry.summary: The align-and-segment approach jointly learns label alignment and semantic segmentation when images and labels come from misaligned sources, a common problem in remote sensing with sources like OpenStreetMap. It uses a spatial transformer to apply affine corrections to labels during training.

entry.title: AU-Guided Synthetic Video Generation for Micro-Expression Recognition

author.name: Pei-Sze Tan, Sailaja Rajanala, Yee-Fan Tan, Raphael C. -W. Phan, Huey-Fang Ong

entry.summary: EquiME is a synthetic micro-expression dataset of 75K videos generated via action-unit-guided image-to-video generation from 15K faces across five emotions with demographic metadata. Models trained on it show competitive cross-dataset performance on SAMM and CASME II with low demographic variation.

entry.title: MED-DSLC: Multi-Expert-Domain Classification via Domain Supervision and Logit Calibration

author.name: Zheng Zeng, Deepak Sridhar, Nuno Vasconcelos

entry.summary: MED-DSLC addresses the degraded cross-domain calibration that arises when independently trained LoRA experts for CLIP-based zero-shot classification are merged. It uses domain supervision and logit calibration to restore globally comparable logits across specialized domain experts.

entry.title: GHOST: Geometry-Guided Hallucination of Opaque Surface Textures

author.name: Langxu Zhao, Zuan Gu, Tianhan Gao

entry.summary: GHOST is a geometry-guided preprocessing framework that transforms transparent object regions into opaque, structurally consistent representations using visual foundation models, without retraining downstream depth or reconstruction models. It combines transparency decomposition, surface normal recovery, and geometry-semantic integration.

entry.title: Parallax Portrait Matting

author.name: Xin Cai, Jiawen Chen, Lars Jebe, Tianfan Xue, Zhoutong Zhang

entry.summary: Parallax Portrait Matting is a two-frame matting method that uses a second image captured with slight viewpoint change, exploiting foreground-background parallax naturally present in burst photography. It avoids specialized capture setups like green screens or polarized lighting.

entry.title: Structure-Detail Decoupled Autoregressive Generation for Fast and High-Fidelity Virtual Try-On

author.name: Lu Yang, Xiaonan Hu, Yanan Li, Daqi Liu, Xiang Bai, Hao Lu

entry.summary: This paper introduces VAR-VTON, a visual autoregressive virtual try-on model with structure-detail decoupled generation to enable fast, high-fidelity garment synthesis while preserving person identity. It provides an effective bi-conditioning mechanism for VAR models, previously unexplored for try-on, avoiding the high-frequency detail loss of latent-compression diffusion.

entry.title: ASUMOT: Motion-Consistency-Based Asynchronous UAV Detection and Tracking with Event Cameras

author.name: Baofeng Jia, Xiaoyu Chen, Jingyuan Zhang, Zongze Wu, Haochen li, Jing Han, Lianfa Bai

entry.summary: ASUMOT is a motion-consistency-based asynchronous framework for detecting and tracking long-range UAVs directly on raw event-camera data, where targets appear as sparse fragmented blobs. It models each UAV as a set of motion-consistent event blobs with a local estimator, lightweight verifier, and motion cues to avoid duplicate trajectories.

entry.title: HierCAD: Hierarchical Text-to-CAD Design via Structure Alignment and Parameter Grounding

author.name: Jimin Xu, Tianbao Wang, Tao Jin, Zhou Zhao

entry.summary: HierCAD is a hierarchical text-to-CAD framework that decomposes CAD construction trees into object-level procedural reasoning and part-level topology reasoning trajectories to improve structural consistency and parameter grounding. It adds a unified structure-alignment and parameter-grounding learning strategy.

entry.title: Parse, Search, and Confirmation: Training-Free Aerial Vision-and-Dialog Navigation with Chain-of-Thought Reasoning and Structured Spatial Memory

author.name: Yu Qi, Hongyu Li, Shaofei Huang, Tianrui Hui, Yaxiong Wang, Lechao Cheng, Zhun Zhong, Si Liu, Meng Wang

entry.summary: PSC-AVDN is a training-free framework for aerial vision-and-dialog navigation that couples a three-stage parse-search-confirmation reasoning pipeline with structured spatial memory. It uses an LLM to convert ambiguous dialogue into geometric cues and chain-of-thought reasoning for stepwise target exploration under high-altitude UAV views.

entry.title: Robustness and Stability Analysis of Differentiable Shift-Variant FBP for Cone-Beam CT under Challenging Acquisition Settings

author.name: Chengze Ye, Linda-Sophie Schneider, Yipeng Sun, Mareike Thies, Siyuan Mei, Paula Andrea P\'erez-Toro, Siming Bayer, Andreas Maier

entry.summary: Studies the robustness of a differentiable shift-variant filtered backprojection framework for cone-beam CT reconstruction under irregular trajectories and sparse-view conditions. It finds reconstruction is largely insensitive to trajectory ordering but sensitive to spatial sampling distribution.

entry.title: Differentiable Proxy Learning for Adaptive Quantization Control in H.264 Video Coding

author.name: Qihan Xu, Ivan V. Baji\'c

entry.summary: Proposes a differentiable proxy for the H.264 intra codec that enables gradient-based adaptive quantization parameter control for objectives like perceptual quality or machine-vision tasks. It emphasizes explicitly characterizing fidelity of the proxy to the real codec.

entry.title: Diffusion MRI preprocessing affects ADC estimation and automatic PI-RADS v2.1 classification in bi-parametric prostate MRI

author.name: Christos Kanakis, Mathias Perslev, Tim Schakel, Silvia Ingala, Akshay Pai, Dennis Klomp, Chantal M. W. Tax

entry.summary: Investigates how diffusion MRI preprocessing steps (denoising, Gibbs-ringing correction, distortion registration) affect ADC estimation and automatic PI-RADS classification in prostate MRI using the fastMRI cohort. Highlights the lack of standardized preprocessing in prostate imaging.

entry.title: LLM-Centric Agentic AI for UAV Swarms: Architecture, Enabling Technologies, and Open Problems

author.name: Yousef Emami, Rahim Taheri, Mohammadhossein Homaei, Muhammad Atif Ur Rehman, Mohammad Shojafar

entry.summary: A survey/position paper proposing LLM-centric agentic AI architectures for UAV swarms, integrating perception, memory, reasoning, and action into closed-loop cognitive control for search-and-rescue and monitoring. It also discusses the expanded cybersecurity attack surface such systems introduce.

entry.title: SLIDER: Sparse History-Guided Aerial Robot Target Search using Sliding Local Maps

author.name: Xiaolei Hou, Zheng Pan, Hua Lan, Zhenghao Zou, Yinhong Chen, Chenxi Zhu, Yang Lyu, Jinwen Hu, Chunhui Zhao

entry.summary: SLIDER is a lightweight, memory-efficient aerial target-search framework that combines a local sliding map with sparse global history, adds a real-time observation-quality evaluation for frontier detection, and uses incremental viewpoint clustering for scalable planning. It avoids dependence on globally dense maps.

entry.title: Mapping Pamir: Multi-Session Visual-Inertial SLAM and 3D Reconstruction of an Underwater Shipwreck

author.name: Michalis Chatzispyrou, Luke Horgan, Hyunkil Hwang, Harish Sathishchandra, Chinmay Burgul, Monika Roznere, Alberto Quattrini Li, Philippos Mordohai, Ioannis Rekleitis

entry.summary: Presents a multi-session visual-inertial SLAM and 3D reconstruction framework for an underwater shipwreck using an affordable action camera augmented with dive-computer depth, combining SVIn2 trajectories with COLMAP structure-from-motion for dense reconstruction. Calibration targets align sessions into a common frame.

entry.title: Whole-Body Semantic-to-Actuation Grounding of Elephant-Inspired Soft-Trunk Motion via Lightweight Flow Matching

author.name: Tingcong Liu, Tongshun Chen, Siyi Ma, Yuhao Wang, Aye Phyu Phyu Aung, Ibrahim Alsarraj, J. Senthilnath, Bo An, Ke Wu

entry.summary: Introduces a whole-body semantic-to-actuation grounding framework for elephant-inspired soft-trunk robots that converts multimodal LLM responses into bounded intent-intensity tuples and generates feasible tendon-actuation trajectories via lightweight rectified flow. It targets expressive close-contact human-robot interaction.

entry.title: Stop to Decide: Latency-Aware Proprioceptive Navigation Primitives for Mapping-Free Quadruped Inspection

author.name: Hanting Suo, Haonan Yan, Liang Wang, Aiguo Song

entry.summary: Analyzes how compute-induced latency (about 15 Hz navigation loop) breaks a common proprioceptive stair-summit detection pattern for quadrupeds, causing overshoot, and shows a stop-to-decide climb-settle cadence keeps overshoot near zero across loop rates. It offers latency-aware mapping-free navigation primitives.

entry.title: CR-Solver: GPU-Accelerated Kinematics Solver for Tendon-driven Continuum Robots

author.name: Heqing Yang, Yang Yi, Linqing Zhong, Linjiang Huang, Si Liu

entry.summary: CR-Solver is a two-stage GPU-accelerated optimization-based kinematics solver for tendon-driven continuum robots that unifies inverse kinematics, path following, and trajectory planning in one constrained nonlinear framework. It addresses the gap left by rigid-body-based planning libraries.

entry.title: From Sketch Prior to Trajectories: A Mission-Oriented Coordinated Navigation Framework for Indoor UAV Swarm

author.name: Xinhang Xu, Ruiyang Liu, Haotian Jin, Yi Wang, Hongming Shen, Jianping Li, Lihua Xie

entry.summary: Proposes a mission-oriented coordinated navigation framework for indoor UAV swarms that leverages sketch-map priors (floor plans, CAD, evacuation diagrams) and exploits fixed-altitude planar connectivity to sequence region visits and generate trajectories. It targets inspection, patrol, and delivery rather than exploration.

entry.title: Better Call Sol The Workhorse

author.name: Zvi

entry.summary: Zvi Mowshowitz aggregates community reactions to OpenAI GPT-5.6-Sol and its cheaper Terra and Luna variants, comparing them against Anthropic Fable across intelligence, alignment, and workflow fit. Note that these models had general availability in late June 2026, so this is analysis of existing models rather than a launch announcement.

entry.title: TC-MAF: Train-Calibrated Bounded Multi-Evidence Fusion for Multimodal Industrial Anomaly Detection

author.name: Ming Deng, Sijin Sun, Xiaochuan Hu, Xing Wu

entry.summary: TC-MAF is a base-anchored multi-evidence fusion design for multimodal industrial anomaly detection combining a multimodal detector, complementary Dinomaly evidence, and a cross-modal consistency cue under a fixed fusion formula. A training-dispersion confidence term scales auxiliary participation using only normal training statistics, reaching strong MVTec-3D results.

entry.title: PREF-Gate: Provenance-Constrained Relational Evidence Fusion with Validation-Gated Selection for Graph Fraud Detection

author.name: Liming Liu, Chao Hu, Mingfei Lu, Yiwei Ge, Xingle Li, Heyuan Shi

entry.summary: Presents PREF-Gate for graph fraud detection, separating label-free context evidence from self-excluded training-label neighborhood evidence to avoid leakage, with a validation gate to select between experts. Emphasizes provenance-constrained, auditable decisions.

entry.title: Graph Neural Networks for RFID-Based Spatial Geometry Inference in Spatial AI Systems
